caption:
💀 Europe's population — 1300 → 1600.

The Black Death emptied Europe in four years. Getting the people back took two centuries. From about 74 million in 1347 to 52 million by 1400 — and the fall continued after 1351, because the plague kept coming back. Europe only cleared its pre-plague peak around 1550.

📊 Data: reconstructed series, interpolated between published estimates (Russell, Benedictow; synthesis via Encyclopedia.com). Values between the anchors are indicative only.
